psalm-48-1.verse: Great is the Lord, and greatly to be praised, In the city of our God, His holy mountain.
psalm-48-1.prayer: Lord, You are great and greatly to be praised. Help me worship You with reverence, gratitude, and joy.

psalm-48-2.verse: Beautiful in elevation, the joy of the whole earth, Is Mount Zion in the far north, The city of the great King.
psalm-48-2.prayer: Father, thank You for the beauty and majesty of Your kingdom. Help me keep my focus on what is eternal.

psalm-48-3.verse: God, in her palaces, Has made Himself known as a stronghold.
psalm-48-3.prayer: Lord, thank You for being known as a refuge for Your people. Help me run to You whenever I face challenges.

psalm-48-4.verse: For, lo, the kings assembled themselves, They passed by together.
psalm-48-4.prayer: Father, remind me that earthly powers are limited, but Your authority is without end.

psalm-48-5.verse: They saw it, then they were amazed; They were terrified, they fled in alarm.
psalm-48-5.prayer: Lord, thank You that Your presence causes fear and uncertainty to fade. Help me trust You completely.

psalm-48-6.verse: Panic seized them there, Anguish, as of a woman in childbirth.
psalm-48-6.prayer: Father, when anxiety or fear comes, strengthen my heart and remind me that You are near.

psalm-48-7.verse: With the east wind You break the ships of Tarshish.
psalm-48-7.prayer: Lord, no force on earth can stand against Your purposes. Help me trust in Your sovereign power.

psalm-48-8.verse: As we have heard, so have we seen In the city of the Lord of hosts, in the city of our God; God will establish her forever. Selah.
psalm-48-8.prayer: Father, thank You for Your faithfulness throughout generations. Help me remember Your works and trust Your promises.

psalm-48-9.verse: We have thought on Your lovingkindness, O God, In the midst of Your temple.
psalm-48-9.prayer: Lord, I meditate on Your lovingkindness. Fill my heart with gratitude for Your mercy and grace.

psalm-48-10.verse: As is Your name, O God, So is Your praise to the ends of the earth; Your right hand is full of righteousness.
psalm-48-10.prayer: Father, Your name is worthy of praise throughout the earth. Let my life bring honor and glory to You.

psalm-48-11.verse: Let Mount Zion be glad, Let the daughters of Judah rejoice Because of Your judgments.
psalm-48-11.prayer: Lord, thank You for Your righteousness and perfect justice. Help me walk in Your ways.

psalm-48-12.verse: Walk about Zion and go around her; Count her towers;
psalm-48-12.prayer: Father, help me remember and celebrate the ways You have worked in my life.

psalm-48-13.verse: Consider her ramparts; Go through her palaces, That you may tell it to the next generation.
psalm-48-13.prayer: Lord, let me faithfully pass on the testimony of Your goodness to future generations.

psalm-48-14.verse: For such is God, Our God forever and ever; He will guide us until death.
psalm-48-14.prayer: Father, thank You for being my God forever and ever. Guide me throughout my life and keep me close to You.

psalm-48-closing.verse:
Lord, thank You for Your greatness, faithfulness, and lovingkindness. You are my refuge, my guide, and my eternal King. Help me trust in Your power, remember Your goodness, and walk faithfully in Your ways. Let my life continually bring praise to Your name, and help me share the testimony of Your faithfulness with others. Thank You for leading me today and for being my God forever.

In Jesus’ name, Amen. 🙏🏻
